title: Compose
description: Typed navigation helpers and a structured ViewModel base for Compose apps.

pages.title: Typed navigation
pages.summary: Centralize routes and arguments with a typed Destination contract and helpers.

api.name: Destination
api.signature: interface Destination { val route: String; val arguments: List<NamedNavArgument> }
api.summary: Base contract for navigation destinations (typically implemented via a sealed class/interface).

api.name: KNavHost
api.signature: @Composable fun KNavHost(navController: NavHostController, startDestination: Destination, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, builder: NavGraphBuilder.() -> Unit)
api.summary: Typed wrapper around NavHost to avoid raw route strings at call sites.

api.name: NavController.navigate
api.signature: fun NavController.navigate(destination: Destination, navOptions: NavOptions? = null, navigatorExtras: Navigator.Extras? = null)

api.name: NavController.popBackTo
api.signature: fun NavController.popBackTo(destination: Destination, inclusive: Boolean = false): Boolean
api.summary: Pop the back stack to a typed Destination.

pages.title: KViewModel
pages.summary: StateFlow + SharedFlow foundation with async helpers (fetchData/collectData).

api.name: KViewModel
api.signature: abstract class KViewModel<State, Event>(initialState: State) : ViewModel()
api.summary: Structured base ViewModel for Compose-driven UIs: state, one-shot events, and async helpers.
